notes: Cursor was explicitly reauthorized on 2026-07-30. Version and configuration checks are non-paid; no model prompt is used as a health probe.

Chrome DevTools MCP is task-scoped and is never persisted in fleet host configuration. The owning browser skills route to a host-native browser capability or launch the upstream command only when diagnostics are requested.
Playwright is intentionally not a dependency of this toolkit. Existing repository or host Playwright installations remain independent.

The latest MCP SDK is pinned with an @hono/node-server 2.0.11 security override because the SDK's declared transitive range otherwise resolves Windows path-traversal and WebSocket-handshake advisories. The toolkit uses only the SDK stdio client and validates this override with npm audit and the live smoke.
vite-plugin-devtools-json is recorded for conditional repository integration and is not installed by this toolkit.
